label: DisasterReady India - Mobile Home & Alerts
title: DisasterReady India - Mobile Home & Alerts
prompt: Mobile Citizen Public Portal (P2 / Home): Amber hazard alert banner at top ("Move to higher ground now. Rani river is above danger level at Kharadi. Water is rising." Updated 4 min ago, source CWC & DDMA). Exactly four primary touch actions (min 56px height, transit-line styled with 2px line Lucide icons): "Get to safety" (/safety/1), "Ask for supplies" (/supplies/1), "Check my request" (/track), and "Call for help" (/emergency). Quick status row with last sync and connectivity badge. Small utility links: "Listen", "Make text larger", "Low-data mode", "Family safety plan", "Settings". Strict Government of India design language, clean tabular layout, no decorative cards or gradients. Persistent emergency bar cleared by bottom spacing.
